sentences.text:
Shri Amitabh Gupta - Advocate for the appellant (throug
 Shri Vikram Singh - Advocate for the respondent.
Heard on I.A. No.13446/2025, an application for urgent hearing during summer vacation.
For the reason stated in the application, I.A. No.13446/2025 is allowed.
Heard on admission.
Appeal seems arguable, therefore, it is admitted for hearing.
Let record of the concerned trial court be called for.
Also heard on IA No.13459/2025, an application under Section 374(2) of the Cr.P.C. for suspension of remaining jail sentence and grant of bail to appellant - Dr. Pritesh Singh.

Arising out of judgment dated 16.05.2025 passed by Special Judge, Vyapam Bhopal, (M,.P.) in S.T. No.555/2025 the appellant has been convicted under Section 419 of I.P.C.
and sentenced to undergo R.I. for 3 years and with fine of Rs.2,000/-, Sections 420 of I.P.C. and sentenced to undergo R.I. for 3 years and with fine of Rs.2,000/-, Sections 467 of I.P.C. and sentenced to undergo R.I. for 3 years and with fine of Rs.2,000/-, Sections 468 of I.P.C. and sentenced to undergo R.I. for 3 years and with fine of Rs.2,000/-, Sections 471 of I.P.C. and sentenced to undergo R.I. for 3 years and with fine of Rs.2,000/- , Sections 120 (b) of I.P.C. and sentenced to undergo R.I. for 3 years and with fine of Rs.2,000/-, Sections 3 -Gh (1) (2) read with Section 4 of The Madhya Pradesh Recognized Examinations Act, 1937, and sentenced to undergo R.I. for 3 years 2 CRA-5342-2025 and with fine of Rs.2,000/- with default stipulations.
Learned counsel for the appellant submits that Trial Court has already suspended the sentence of the appellant till 15.06.2025.
Final hearing of this appeal is not possible in near future.
Thus, it is prayed that remaining jail sentence of the appellant may be suspended.
The prayer is opposed by learned counsel for the respondent.

Considering the short sentence awarded coupled with the fact that final hearing of this appeal is not possible in near future, we Dr Pritesh Singh vs Union Of India on 9 June, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/59644364/
1 deem it proper to suspend the remaining jail sentence of the appellant.

sentences.text: Accordingly, I.A. No.13459/2025 is allowed.

Subject to depositing the fine amount, if not already deposited, the remaining jail sentence of the appellant- Dr. Pritesh Singh is hereby suspended and it is directed that he be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond for a sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with one solvent surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial court with a further direction to appear before the Registry of the High Court of Madhya Pradesh on 22.09.2025 and also on such other dates, as may be fixed by Registry of the High Court of Madhya Pradesh in this regard during the pendency of this appeal.
List the matter for final hearing in due course.

C. c. as per rules  (AVANINDRA KUMAR SINGH) 
 V. JUDGE
